newsitem.title: USA: Puget Energy restoring power after winds.
newsitem.headline: Puget Energy restoring power after winds.

text.p: About 30,000 of Puget Sound Energy's electricity customers still had no power after transmission lines were felled by strong winds on Sunday, a company spokeswoman said Monday afternoon.
As many as 100,000 of the utility's customers experienced outages during the storm, spokeswoman Kristin Wappler said.
Puget expects to have power restored to most remaining customers by Tuesday, but may not have the work completed until Wednesday, she noted.
In addition, a lighting storm is forecast for the Seattle region Monday night.
Puget had as many as 30 transmission lines, all 200 kilovolts or less, down during the storm, but repairs are now down to the neighborhood level, Wappler said.
